interpretation: Localization of a known synthetic pair change; not a unique initiating sensor, physical cause, or validated APS RCA.

settings.candidate_pool: intersection of dependence and marginal complete-pair eligibility
settings.dependence_score: negative Gaussian joint-minus-marginal log-density ratio; no clipping or absolute value

fitting.marginals: observed mean and population standard deviation

settings.marginal_pair_score: maximum of the two committed marginal-deviation scores
settings.missingness: independent Bernoulli per coordinate; constant nuisance also masked; all_missing always NaN
